name: Cosmo Jarvis
bio:
Harrison Cosmo Krikoryan Jarvis is an English actor and singer-songwriter. He has starred in the films Lady Macbeth (2016), Calm with Horses (2019), and Persuasion (2022). In 2024, he portrayed John Blackthorne in the historical drama series Shōgun.
